about.title: Healthcare connected for every profession
about.body: Whether you're a doctor, a constructor, a farmer, or an artist, Ubuzima Bwiza brings world-class medical consultation to your fingertips. We bridge the gap between professional care and daily life through seamless digital accessibility across Rwanda.
